name: Westwood Plaza
summary: Westwood Plaza is a well-maintained shopping destination in Bergen County offering a compelling mix of high-end boutiques, mainstream retailers, and diverse dining options. With professional services including personal shopping and concierge assistance, the center provides a tailored experience that has earned strong customer ratings and loyalty from local families and professionals.
demographics: Westwood Plaza primarily serves middle to upper-middle-income families and professionals from the Bergen County area, with a strong representation of shoppers aged 30-55. The trade area draws from Westwood's affluent suburban communities, characterized by high household incomes, educated residents, and family-oriented demographics typical of northern New Jersey. Visitors tend to be convenience-focused shoppers seeking a mix of everyday necessities and specialty retail, with a preference for quality brands and personalized service that reflects the area's discerning consumer base.
description: Westwood Plaza has established itself as a premier shopping destination in Bergen County, New Jersey, serving the Westwood community and surrounding areas since its inception. Located at 700 Broadway, this well-maintained shopping center offers visitors an exceptional blend of high-end retail boutiques, mainstream brands, and diverse dining options that cater to the area's discerning clientele. The plaza distinguishes itself through its emphasis on customer service, featuring professional amenities including personal shopping assistance, concierge services, and event hosting capabilities that create a tailored shopping experience. With a strategic layout designed for easy navigation and modern facilities that prioritize cleanliness and comfort, the center has earned a solid 4.1-star rating from over 400 customer reviews. Shoppers consistently praise the vibrant atmosphere, the mix of luxury and affordable retail options, and the quality food court featuring diverse cuisine including Asian specialties and Mexican fare, making Westwood Plaza a go-to destination for both everyday shopping needs and special occasions.
